entities.summary: The Kyiv Academic Puppet Theatre is a theatre in Kyiv in Ukraine. It was founded on October 27, 1927. It is the oldest puppet theatre in Kyiv. Kyiv State Academic Puppet Theatre is a theatre building in Europe, established in 1927. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
